section_name: Mean absolute error and mean squared error

candidates.title: Theoria combinationis observationum erroribus minimis obnoxiae
candidates.reason: Carl Friedrich Gauss's original memoir introduces the mean squared error criterion in Part I, Article 6. Presented in 1821, it was published in 1823. [Primary source](https://www.e-rara.ch/zut/content/titleinfo/899269). This supplies historical attribution; the five-observation calculations and exact fit at b=3 follow algebraically from the supplied observations.
